# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class OpeningRangeBreakoutAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)

        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)

        self._orb = self.orb(self._spy.symbol, 9, 30, 10, 0, Resolution.MINUTE)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._orb = OpeningRangeBreakout(9, 30, 10, 0)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._spy, self._orb)
        # self.register_indicator(self._spy, self._orb)

        self.plot_indicator("ORB", self._orb)

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._spy.symbol),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._spy.symbol, 30),
            self._exit_orb
        )

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if not data.bars or not self._orb.is_ready:
            return

        bar = data.bars.get(self._spy.symbol)
        if not bar:
            return

        price = bar.close

        if not self._spy.holdings.is_long and price > self._orb.high:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy.symbol, 1)

        if self._spy.holdings.is_short and price < self._orb.low:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy.symbol, -1)

    def _exit_orb(self) -> None:
        if self.portfolio.invested:
            self.liquidate()
